title: Party Service Health Check Response
description: Schema for validating /health/ready endpoint - checks BETAConnectivity, DatabaseConnectivity, and ValidationServiceConnectivity

status.description: Overall health status - Healthy if all checks pass, Unhealthy if any fail

name.description: Name of the dependency check without spaces

description.description: Healthy when check passes, or error details (HTTP codes, error messages) when check fails
